annotations.title: Target or exclude a Microsoft audience

description: Put an audience to work on a Microsoft Advertising campaign or ad group — e.g. the customer list from create_microsoft_ads_customer_list, to retarget it or EXCLUDE existing customers. action add (audienceId, exclude, bidAdjustment -90..900 %) or remove (criterionIds from list_microsoft_ads_audience_targeting). Microsoft allows biddable audiences at the campaign OR the ad-group level of one campaign, not both; exclusions at both; Performance Max can only exclude. Targeting or removing on a LIVE campaign needs confirm:true. Read back. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

adGroupId.description: ad group to target or exclude the audience on; pass this or campaignId

bidAdjustment.description: -90 to 900 (%); 0 = target without changing the bid

campaignId.description: campaign to target or exclude the audience on; pass this or adGroupId

confirm.description: true required on a LIVE campaign when targeting or removing

criterionIds.description: criterion ids to remove (action remove), from list_microsoft_ads_audience_targeting

exclude.description: true = exclude this audience instead of targeting it

name: set_microsoft_ads_audience_targeting
title: Target or exclude a Microsoft audience
